tables.name: _user
columns: role           NVARCHAR(50),           -- ADMIN, ORGANIZER, JUDGE, GUEST_JUDGE, MENTOR, PARTICIPANT
approved       BIT DEFAULT 0,          -- Admin duyệt Organizer/Judge/Mentor
is_verified    BIT DEFAULT 0,          -- Participant tự xác thực qua OTP

tables.name: track
columns: FOREIGN KEY (hackathon_event_id) REFERENCES hackathon_event(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: event_registration
columns: FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES hackathon_event(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY (user_id)  REFERENCES _user(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

tables.name: round
columns: FOREIGN KEY (hackathon_event_id) REFERENCES hackathon_event(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: criterion
columns: FOREIGN KEY (hackathon_event_id) REFERENCES hackathon_event(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: track_mentor
columns: user_id     BIGINT NOT NULL,   -- MENTOR hoặc JUDGE role
event_id    BIGINT NOT NULL,   -- denormalized để lookup nhanh
assigned_by BIGINT,            -- organizer_id thực hiện phân công
assigned_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE() NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT fk_tm_track    FOREIGN KEY (track_id)    REFERENCES track(id)          ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT fk_tm_event    FOREIGN KEY (event_id)    REFERENCES hackathon_event(id),

tables.name: team_member
columns: FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES team(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES _user(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: team_invitation
columns: status        NVARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'PENDING', -- PENDING, ACCEPTED, DECLINED
FOREIGN KEY (team_id)    REFERENCES team(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,

tables.name: submission
columns: FOREIGN KEY (team_id)  REFERENCES team(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,

tables.name: judge_assignment
columns: FOREIGN KEY (round_id)                 REFERENCES round(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

tables.name: score
columns: is_finalized  BIT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,          -- thêm từ patch.sql
FOREIGN KEY (submission_id) REFERENCES submission(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

tables.name: mentorship_request
columns: mentor_id   BIGINT,                            -- NULL nếu chưa có mentor nhận
status      NVARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'OPEN',       -- OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED
FOREIGN KEY (team_id)   REFERENCES team(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,

tables.name: notification
columns: type           NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INFO', -- thêm từ patch.sql
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES _user(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: team_round_advancement
columns: advanced_at   DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE() NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT fk_adv_team       FOREIGN KEY (team_id)       REFERENCES team(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT fk_adv_from_round FOREIGN KEY (from_round_id) REFERENCES round(id),
CONSTRAINT fk_adv_to_round   FOREIGN KEY (to_round_id)   REFERENCES round(id),

tables.name: refresh_token
columns: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES _user(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: password_reset_token
columns: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES _user(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: support_tickets
columns: created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
